composition_convention: x = b + (p - b) * nominal_stock_volume_percent / 100. Additive-volume/equal-water-molarity approximation; not an exact gravimetric atom-fraction conversion.

internal_standard_preparation.low_mid: 50 uL DMSO-d6 in 4.45 mL DMSO-h6; described as 1.1%
internal_standard_preparation.stage_mapping: Stages 1-2 use low/mid preparation; stages 3-7 use high preparation, following the supplied protocol.
internal_standard_preparation.handling: Assume matched preparation within each calibration segment. No extra 0.95 multiplier or division; no separate blank subtraction.

calibration: Two sequential groups: low standards including two water measurements fit background and response; high standards use the fitted background. No fixed natural-abundance subtraction.
inventory_limitations: Electrolyte-volume proxy, not recovered-water yield. Stage 2 directly receives product 1; stages 3-7 are separately prepared feeds.
